title: Sky's The Limit Ballooning Adventures
specs: Perfect safety record with over 60,000 passengers flown since 1994
Pilots are FAA Commercial Certified with at least 12 years flight experience
Flights can reach altitudes of 3,000 to 4,000 feet
Pregnant women and children under 5 may not fly
Weight limit 240 lbs per person, 480 lbs combined; call if over limit
Must be in good health to fly
European baskets range from 4 to 16 passengers; larger balloons have separate compartments

services.name: Flight Details
services.desc: Total trip time includes: Transport from meeting location to launch field, setup of the balloon and the flight. After everyone arrives at our meeting location, we will transport you in one of our vans to one of our launch sites. Once we arrive we will test out the winds aloft with one of our test balloons in order to determine the best location to launch from based on the wind conditions for the day. You’ll then get to see the whole process of the balloons being inflated ready for your unforgettable flight. Once we are all aboard we’ll begin our floating ascent into the skies. quotes.text: My girlfriend wanted "romantic" and I wanted "fun" so we went on a hot air balloon ride. What a hoot.

We just finished a sunrise ride over Temecula, and it was beautiful. Our pilot, Jeff, was wonderful and very experienced. The ride lasted just over an hour and we finished with muffins and mimosas and a little history of ballooning. Great views of mountains, vineyards and sunrise. The ride was relaxing and peaceful, reaching max height of 5200 feet. I would definitely recommend Sky’s the Limit Adventure and will come back to them again

Most fun you can have legally. You get so high and see so much. I’ve lived in the north county coastal for almost 30 years and have never seen the places I’ve seen today. Going over Rancho Santa Fe was magnificient. These guys are pros and the way they pilot, yes pilot, the balloon is something to behold. Do yourself a favor and mark off that bucket list line and ride this hot air balloon!

The flight was so smooth, the scenery absolutely beautiful!! We were also very impressed by the smooth landing!! After we got home my dad said he wanted to do it again! Thanks about an awesome evening!!
This was my first experience and I cannot wait to do it again. The guys were friendly and informative and safe. If you are thinking about booking, do not hesitate!!!
The flight was exciting. An unforgettable experience - The pilot and ground crew did a wonderful job and we had a fun and memorable experience.

Last night I took my 92 year old dad on a hot air balloon ride with Sky’s The Limit Ballooning Adventures and I can’t begin to tell you how impressed I (we) were about the whole experience from check in to drop off. The crew and pilot could not have been nicer or more accommodating helping him get in and out of the basket. The flight was so smooth, the scenery absolutely beautiful!! We were also very impressed by the smooth landing!! After we got home my dad said he wanted to do it again! Thanks about an awesome evening!!
